findings.summary: Circular capture identity reconstructed an exact legacy-sized player box and omitted collision owners whose modern shapes protrude into the queried body or support probe.
findings.upstream_behavior: Fixed upstream CircularCropMacro#updateState and AbstractMacro#onTick read mc.thePlayer, GameStateHandler, and live world collision state on the client tick; they do not require an independently reconstructed AABB to equal a captured AABB.
findings.incompatibility: Minecraft 26.1.2 EntityDimensions stores width and height as float and makeBoundingBox widens after float division, while the leaf used exact 0.3D/1.8D coordinates and CaptureIdentityLedger exact equality. CollisionShapeSnapshot also permits bounded local shapes outside [0,1], but the request planner captured only origins overlapping the body/support boxes.
findings.replacement: Use the float-derived standing envelope only as a capture bound, accept positive centered pose-subset boxes with numeric tolerance, run movement queries against the captured playerBox, and capture every clearance/support collision origin implied by CollisionShapeSnapshot bounds. Shifted or oversized boxes still fail closed, preserving upstream live-player semantics.
findings.automated_evidence: javap of Minecraft 26.1.2 EntityDimensions verified float width/height and fdiv-to-double bounding-box construction; CircularCropMacroTest.floatDerivedStandingAndShortPoseBoxesRemainCurrent and everyDirectionRequestsItsBodySupportAndCollisionOriginHalo pass in the focused Gradle suite.

findings.summary: Cocoa capture identity reconstructed an exact legacy-sized player box and its four walkability requests omitted protruding collision owners.
findings.upstream_behavior: Fixed upstream SShapeCocoaBeanMacro#updateState, #invokeState, #hasLineChanged, and #shouldHugWall use live player coordinates and GameStateHandler/BlockUtils observations on the client tick.
findings.incompatibility: The modern production snapshot uses LocalPlayer.getBoundingBox with float-derived dimensions and pose-dependent height, so exact 0.3D/1.8D equality can reject current captures. Bounded shapes owned outside each front/back/side body or support grid were also absent from request.blocks().
findings.replacement: Bind captures to a centered pose-subset box inside the float-derived standing envelope, query walkability with the captured playerBox, and include the exact collision-origin halo for each front/back/side clearance and support probe. Token, world, bounds, shifted-box, and unknown-evidence rejection remain intact.
findings.automated_evidence: SShapeCocoaBeanMacroTest.floatDerivedStandingAndShortPoseBoxesRemainCurrent, walkabilityCaptureIncludesProtrudingCollisionOrigins, and staleCaptureTokenBodyWorldAndPauseGenerationFailClosed pass in the focused Gradle suite.

findings.summary: Default melon/pumpkin capture identity used an exact synthetic player box and obstacle/lane requests omitted protruding collision owners.
findings.upstream_behavior: Fixed upstream SShapeMelonPumpkinDefaultMacro#updateState, #invokeState, and #calculateDirection inspect the live player and BlockUtils/GameStateHandler state before selecting rows or lanes.
findings.incompatibility: Exact double reconstruction does not equal Minecraft 26.1.2's float-derived or shorter pose boxes. The modern collision model allows a neighboring origin's shape to intersect a scanned body or support probe, but those origins were not captured.
findings.replacement: Use a tolerant centered pose-subset identity, captured playerBox movement queries, and collision-bound origin halos for row obstacle and lane walkability requests. Crop target probes and upstream crop-before-obstacle ordering are unchanged.
findings.automated_evidence: SShapeMelonPumpkinDefaultMacroTest.floatDerivedStandingAndShortPoseBoxesRemainCurrent, obstacleCaptureIncludesProtrudingCollisionOrigins, and staleTokenAndChangedPlayerFootprintFailClosedWithoutDraws pass in the focused Gradle suite.

findings.summary: The 45-degree mushroom leaf required exact synthetic player-box equality and omitted collision owners outside each side-scan body/support grid.
findings.upstream_behavior: Fixed upstream SShapeMushroomMacro#updateState, #invokeState, #mushroom45DegreeSide, and #calculateDirection consume live player/collision state without reconstructing an exact independent AABB.
findings.incompatibility: Minecraft 26.1.2 float dimensions and pose height make exact 0.3D/1.8D identity invalid. A collision shape owned at the bounded outer origin can reach the logical distance-179 body even though that owner is at distance 180.
findings.replacement: Accept centered pose-subset production boxes within the float-derived standing envelope, query side walkability with the captured playerBox, and capture bounded collision origins through the outer distance-180 owner while retaining the logical scan cap at 179.
findings.automated_evidence: SShapeMushroomMacroTest.floatDerivedStandingAndShortPoseBoxesRemainCurrent and scanCoversOneThrough179AndCapturesOnlyTheRequiredOuterOrigin pass; the latter requires distance 180 and rejects distance 181.

findings.summary: The rotating mushroom leaf required exact synthetic player-box equality and omitted protruding collision owners from direction and lane captures.
findings.upstream_behavior: Fixed upstream SShapeMushroomRotateMacro#updateState, #invokeState, #shouldRotateAfterWarp, and #calculateDirection use live player and block observations; the leaf explicitly disables generic post-warp rotation.
findings.incompatibility: Float-derived and shorter modern player boxes cannot satisfy exact synthetic equality, and request.blocks() lacked bounded neighboring origins whose shapes can intersect the scanned body/support probes.
findings.replacement: Use tolerant centered pose-subset identity, captured playerBox queries, and collision-origin halos for side scans and lane transitions. The upstream rotation ordering, previous-lane drop repair, and post-warp disablement remain unchanged.
findings.automated_evidence: SShapeMushroomRotateMacroTest.floatDerivedStandingAndShortPoseBoxesRemainCurrent and directionCaptureIncludesProtrudingCollisionOrigins pass in the focused Gradle suite alongside shifted/stale capture tests.

findings.summary: The mushroom SDS leaf required exact synthetic player-box equality and omitted protruding collision owners from lateral/back walkability captures.
findings.upstream_behavior: Fixed upstream SShapeMushroomSDSMacro#updateState, #invokeState, and #calculateDirection use live player, BlockUtils, and GameStateHandler observations for lateral farming and backward lane switching.
findings.incompatibility: Production AABBs are float-derived and pose-sensitive rather than exact 0.3D/1.8D boxes. Neighbor-owned bounded shapes may intersect the lateral/back body or support probe without their origins overlapping the queried box.
findings.replacement: Validate centered pose-subset boxes within the float-derived standing envelope, use the captured playerBox for lateral/back queries, and capture collision-origin halos for every such clearance/support pair. alwaysHoldW and exact SDS input semantics are preserved.
findings.automated_evidence: SShapeMushroomSDSMacroTest.floatDerivedStandingAndShortPoseBoxesRemainCurrent and directionCaptureIncludesProtrudingCollisionOrigins pass in the focused Gradle suite.

findings.summary: Sugar-cane capture identity used an exact synthetic player box and its mandatory footing request omitted protruding collision owners.
findings.upstream_behavior: Fixed upstream SShapeSugarcaneMacro#updateState, #invokeState, #calculateDirection, and #getNearestSideWall use live player and BlockUtils/GameStateHandler observations for water routes, walls, and movement.
findings.incompatibility: The production player AABB is float-derived and pose-sensitive, so exact 0.3D/1.8D equality is not a valid current-capture identity. The footing walkability query also needs neighboring origins allowed by CollisionShapeSnapshot bounds.
findings.replacement: Accept centered pose-subset boxes, query footing with the captured playerBox, and include the full bounded collision-origin halo in every request. The approved one-block repair of upstream's literal 11-block D-route typo and the A/D/S priorities remain unchanged.
findings.automated_evidence: SShapeSugarcaneMacroTest.floatDerivedPoseBoxesAndCollisionOriginHaloRemainCurrent and staleTokenEpochBoundsPlayerFootprintAndCompletedPhaseFailClosed pass in the focused Gradle suite.

findings.summary: Vertical-crop capture planning used a synthetic standing footprint for identity/request cells and omitted protruding collision owners across long side scans.
findings.upstream_behavior: Fixed upstream SShapeVerticalCropMacro#updateState, #invokeState, #calculateDirection, and #lagBackDetected operate on the live player and world for crop, void, obstacle, lane, and lag-back decisions.
findings.incompatibility: Float rounding or a shorter current pose can change the synthetic integer footprint at coordinate boundaries. Future conservative clearance/support enumeration requires owner origins outside each body/probe, including the distance-179 long scan, but the bounded request did not contain them.
findings.replacement: Build request envelopes with float-derived standing dimensions, validate centered pose-subset snapshots without requiring the same height, keep all movement queries on captured playerBox, and add exact collision-origin halos for current, lane, and both phased long-side walkability scans while retaining request limits.
findings.automated_evidence: SShapeVerticalCropMacroTest.capturedSnapshotMustMatchPendingBoundsAndPlayerFootprint accepts 1.8F/1.5F current boxes and rejects shifted boxes; longSideRequestsCaptureBodyAndSupportAtBothDistanceBounds checks halo corners at distances 1 and 179 and the MAX_BLOCKS/MAX_AXIS_SPAN limits.

findings.summary: Cocoa onStart(long) rejects negative monotonic ticks supplied by the current raw System.nanoTime clock contract.
findings.upstream_behavior: Fixed upstream SShapeCocoaBeanMacro#onEnable has no arbitrary-origin monotonic timestamp parameter or nonnegative-origin assumption.
findings.incompatibility: At baseline SShapeCocoaBeanMacro.java:113 guards nowNanos as nonnegative, while MacroLifecycle#start passes SystemMonotonicClock.nowNanos and SystemMonotonicClock returns raw System.nanoTime, whose origin is arbitrary and whose value is permitted to be negative.
findings.replacement: AUDIT-003 owns the central SystemMonotonicClock contract repair. No duplicate leaf workaround or out-of-scope clock edit is included here.
findings.automated_evidence: Read-only trace anchors MacroLifecycle.java#start -> clock.nowNanos(), SystemMonotonicClock.java#nowNanos -> System.nanoTime(), and baseline SShapeCocoaBeanMacro.java:113; repair evidence remains owned by AUDIT-003.
